grounding.excerpt: *10     The limits begin on the effective date of this permit and lasting through 3 years from the permit effective date.
*11     The limits apply during the period beginning 3 year from the permit effective date
This permit shall become effective on December 1, 2021. This permit and the authorization to discharge shall expire at midnight, November 30, 2026.

rationale: The obligation asks which single TDS net-increase limit regime governs all FY2025 monthly monitoring periods, but the values do not state a specific regime-interval pairing to affirm or refute. The packet establishes two staged numeric limits: 27,664 lbs/day under footnote *10 (effective date through 3 years from effective date) and 24,992 lbs/day under footnote *11 (beginning 3 years from effective date). With an effective date of December 1, 2021, the 3-year boundary falls on December 1, 2024. Federal FY2025 runs October 1, 2024 through September 30, 2025, so it straddles that boundary: October–November 2024 fall within the first regime interval, while December 2024–September 2025 fall within the second. The evidence therefore supports staged applicability across FY2025 but does not establish that either regime alone governs the entire period_universe, nor does it supply the named regime-interval pairing required for ACCEPT. Per P5, unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported semantic closure.
